_comment: The App Store listing, kept in the repo so it is reviewed like code. `node scripts/asc-metadata.mjs` pushes it: the shared fields once, and each entry in `localizations` to that language on the record (created if missing). English (U.K.) serves all four stores: "bower" is taken as a name in English (U.S.) and English (Australia), and Jada chose (27 Sep) to keep one listing rather than a longer name there. Limits: subtitle 30, keywords 100, promotionalText 170, description 4000. No em dashes.
name: bower

en-GB.subtitle: Value it, write it, post it
en-GB.promotionalText: Photograph it or paste the link. bower writes the listing in each platform's voice and prices it on every platform you sell on, with the listings behind the price.
en-GB.description:
bower turns a few photos of a garment into a listing you can post.

Take up to five photos, or paste the link to the item in a shop. bower reads the label, works out what the item is, and writes the title, description, hashtags and every form field for the platform you sell on, in that platform's own voice. Copy each part straight into Vinted, Depop or eBay.

It gives you a price estimate from the photos alone. When you want the real answer, a market check searches live listings on every platform you sell on and gives you a price for each one, with the listings it came from. Then it recommends where to post and what to ask, net of fees.

What it does

- Reads brand, size and fabric from the care label
- Writes for Vinted, Depop and eBay, each in its own voice
- Fills the form fields: category, condition, colour, parcel size and the rest
- Casual or professional tone, and quick refinements: shorter, more detail, stress the condition
- A price per platform, with the listings it came from
- A text-only history of what you listed and what it was worth

What it will not do

- Log in to your accounts or post for you. No bot, no ban risk
- Invent measurements, claims or a smoke-free home you never mentioned
- Keep your photos. They are read once and discarded

Free: 5 listings and 1 market check a month. Switching platform and refining a listing are always free.

bower Plus: unlimited listings and market checks, billed monthly. It renews automatically until you cancel, which you can do any time in Settings at least a day before it renews. Need a few more listings without subscribing? Buy 10, once, and use them whenever you like.

Sign in with Apple. Nothing else to set up.

bower works in the UK, Ireland, the US and Australia, in your own currency and on your country's own sites.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://bower-jadas-projects-b3cbda3d.vercel.app/privacy

review.notes:
bower is a listing writer for secondhand clothing. Sign in with Apple is the only sign-in, so no demo account is needed: any Apple ID works and gets a fresh account with 5 listings and 1 market check for the month.

To test: on the home screen add photos of any garment (a jumper, a jacket, a pair of trainers; a shot of the care label helps but is optional), tap Write it, and the listing streams in within a few seconds. From the listing you can switch platform (Vinted, Depop, eBay), change tone, tap refinement chips, copy any field, or tap Check the market for a live price search, which takes about ten seconds and can finish in the background with a local notification.

In-app purchases: bower Plus (monthly subscription: unlimited listings and market checks) and a one-off pack of 10 listings. Both are on the paywall, which opens from Profile (bower Plus) or when a meter runs out. Purchases are verified on our server with Apple's signed transaction; Restore purchases is on the paywall.

The country is chosen in Profile (UK, Ireland, US, Australia) and sets the currency and the sites searched.

Photos of anything other than clothing are declined with a message and are not charged. Photos are sent to our backend for analysis and are not stored; the app also runs Apple's on-device Sensitive Content Analysis when that setting is on.

Account deletion is in Profile. The privacy policy is at the URL above.
